02 — The Problem

Healthcare & NGOs are drowning
in operational friction.

  • 📞
    Clinics lose 35–60% of inbound calls outside office hours. Each missed call is a lost patient worth €150–€600 lifetime value.
  • ⏱️
    Doctors spend 2–3 hours/day on admin — typing notes, managing calendars, chasing referrals — instead of treating patients.
  • 🌍
    NGOs lack multilingual 24/7 access to verified resources. Beneficiaries get no answer at night — when they need it most.
  • 📊
    No data on real needs. NGOs cannot prove impact to funders, losing millions in EU grants annually due to poor reporting infrastructure.
  • ⚖️
    Zero EU AI Act compliance in Greek/Cypriot health AI solutions — creating massive regulatory risk for any organisation that deploys AI today.
